rv.q: It would be near impossible to conjure a more perfect lineup.
Synetic’s Sleepy Hollow is gorgeously spine-chilling.
No words are needed to bring on the frights and shivers in this classic American ghost tale.

cn.t: Synetic Theater's wordless, movement-based adaptation earns praise for its jaw-dropping physicality and eerie beauty, blending spine-chilling horror with subtle comedy in a gorgeously reimagined Halloween classic.
